steps: Whisk the curd with a third of the besan, the turmeric, half the chilli powder and some salt.
Whisk in plenty of water, about three cups for four people, until thin and free of lumps.
Mix the rest of the besan with most of the onion, the rest of the chilli powder, the garam masala and a little water into a thick batter.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry on medium heat until crisp and golden, then drain.
In a deep pot, heat a spoon of oil and add the cumin and hing.
Add the remaining chopped onion with the ginger, garlic and green chilli and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the curd mix and keep stirring until it boils, then simmer on low for 20 to 25 minutes until it thickens.
Add the pakoras, cover and let them soak for 10 minutes before serving with rice.
note: The oil includes about 10 ml a person that the pakoras soak up while frying; you need a deeper pan of oil to fry them in.
